executive_summary: Maven build failed with a single compilation error in ColumnServiceImpl. The ColumnDataStore interface is missing the countByColumnId(String) method that ColumnServiceImpl attempts to call at line 25. This is identical to the error in attempt 2, indicating the fix from attempt 2 was not properly applied or committed.

errors.root_cause: ColumnServiceImpl at line 25 calls columnDataStore.countByColumnId(columnId) but ColumnDataStore interface does not declare this method. This error persists from attempt 2.
errors.fix_recommendation: Add method signature 'long countByColumnId(String columnId);' to the ColumnDataStore interface and ensure the change is committed to the repository.
